summary: NewGenIvf Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into an additional share purchase agreement to acquire a further 4% equity interest in PredicXion Group Limited (K25.ai). Total consideration is US$4,000,000, comprising US$1,900,000 in cash or digital assets and 1,500,000 newly issued Class A ordinary shares. A US$100,000 cash deposit is due at signing, with the balance due by September 30, 2026. Upon completion, NewGenIvf will hold an aggregate 10% stake based on an implied valuation of US$100 million for PredicXion. The shares issued are restricted under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for regulatory approvals and share delivery mechanics.
